English: Hammer Stand
A simple, mobile wooden rack for hammers and basic tools, providing minimal smithing ability for a traveling clan.
Basic Anvil Shed
A makeshift iron-topped anvil beneath a crude hide shelter, allowing for rudimentary repairs and toolmaking on the move.
Simple Smithy
A semi-permanent forge, with a portable bellows and a dirt floor, enabling the production of basic weapons and horse tack for the horde.
Ironworkers Hut
A sturdy wooden hut with a clay forge and small team of smiths, improving the clans ability to equip warriors and repair gear rapidly.
Blacksmith Pavilion
A large tented area with several anvils and forges, where clan smiths work in shifts to maintain and enhance weapons for the horde.
Fine Forging Room
A semi-permanent timber and daub structure, with advanced forges and trained artisans, producing superior weapons and harnesses for the clan.
Guild Smithy
A renowned smithing guild operates from this robust structure, attracting skilled crafters and increasing the clans ability to outfit large hordes.
Weaponsmith Hall
A fortified hall dedicated to the production of fine arms and armor, where master smiths work under the protection of the clan.
Master Smith Workshop
An elite smithing compound where legendary craftsmen forge signature weapons and armor, raising the status and strength of the horde.
West Grand Forge
The legendary Grand Forge of the West Germanic nomads, a sprawling and nearly immobile smithing complex, famous across the steppe for outfitting entire clans with unmatched arms and armor.
